source.text:
include:
  - template: Security/SAST.gitlab-ci.yml
  - template: Security/Dependency-Scanning.gitlab-ci.yml
  - template: Security/Secret-Detection.gitlab-ci.yml
  - component: ${CI_SERVER_FQDN}/gitlab-org/components/danger-review/danger-review@2.1.0
  - component: ${CI_SERVER_FQDN}/components/code-intelligence/golang-code-intel@v0.1.2
    inputs:
      golang_version: ${GO_VERSION}
      stage: post-test

stages:
  - prepare
  - lint
  - test
  - post-test
  - release

variables:
  FF_USE_FASTZIP: "true"
  TRANSFER_METER_FREQUENCY: "1s"
  GOPATH: $CI_PROJECT_DIR/.GOPATH
  DEBIAN_VERSION: "trixie"
  POLICY: pull
  CI_DEBUG_SERVICES: "true"
  GO_VERSION: "1.26"
  NILAWAY_VERSION: "v0.0.0-20260915140140-59aa42bdc591"
  UBI_VERSION: "9.6"
  GITLAB_ADVANCED_SAST_ENABLED: "true"
  IMAGE_TAG: "latest"
  DEFAULT_IMAGE: "registry.gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab-build-images/debian-${DEBIAN_VERSION}-golang-${GO_VERSION}:${IMAGE_TAG}"
  FIPS_IMAGE_TAG: "latest"
  FIPS_IMAGE: "registry.gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab-build-images/ubi-${UBI_VERSION}-golang-${GO_VERSION}:${FIPS_IMAGE_TAG}"
  GOTOOLCHAIN: local
  GLAB_VERSION: "v1.120.0"

workflow:
  rules: &workflow_rules # For merge requests, create a pipeline.
    - if: "$CI_MERGE_REQUEST_IID"
    # For `main` branch, create a pipeline (this includes on schedules, pushes, merges, etc.).
    - if: '$CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "main"'
    # For tags, create a pipeline.
    - if: "$CI_COMMIT_TAG"

.rules:go-changes:
  rules:
    - changes: &go_change_paths
        - .gitlab-ci.yml
        - "go.mod"
        - "go.sum"
        - "**/*.go"

.rules:ssh-audit:
  rules:
    - changes: *go_change_paths
    - changes:
        - Makefile
        - "support/ssh-audit/**/*"

default:
  image: ${DEFAULT_IMAGE}
  tags:
    - gitlab-org

.cached-go: &cached_go
  - key:
      prefix: "golang-${GO_VERSION}-cache"
      files:
        - go.mod
        - go.sum
    policy: $POLICY
    paths:
      - .GOPATH/pkg/mod/

.cached-go-job:
  variables:
    CACHE_COMPRESSION_LEVEL: "fastest"
  cache:
    - *cached_go

# The pinned ssh-audit download, cached so the ssh-audit jobs do not depend on
# github.com being reachable on every run. Keyed on the Makefile so bumping
# SSH_AUDIT_VERSION invalidates it.
.cached-ssh-audit: &cached_ssh_audit
  key:
    prefix: "ssh-audit"
    files:
      - Makefile
  paths:
    - support/bin/ssh-audit-*

.cached-job:
  cache:
    - *cached_go

.go-matrix-job:
  parallel:
    matrix:
      - GO_VERSION: ["1.26", "1.27"]

################################################################################
# Prepare jobs
################################################################################

modules:download:
  stage: prepare
  extends:
    - .cached-go-job
    - .go-matrix-job
  variables:
    POLICY: pull-push
  script:
    - go mod download

################################################################################
# Test jobs
################################################################################

.test-job:
  needs: ["modules:download"]
  rules: !reference [".rules:go-changes", rules]
  variables:
    GITALY_CONNECTION_INFO: '{"address":"tcp://gitaly:8075", "storage":"default"}'
  before_script:
    # Set up the environment to run integration tests
    - make build
    - cp config.yml.example config.yml
    - go version
  services:
    - name: registry.gitlab.com/gitlab-org/build/cng/gitaly:master
      # Disable the hooks so we don't have to stub the GitLab API
      command:
        [
          "bash",
          "-c",
          "mkdir -p /home/git/repositories && rm -rf /srv/gitlab-shell/hooks/* && touch /srv/gitlab-shell/.gitlab_shell_secret && exec /usr/bin/env GITALY_TESTING_NO_GIT_HOOKS=1 /scripts/process-wrapper",
        ]
      alias: gitaly

tests:
  extends:
    - .cached-job
    - .go-matrix-job
    - .test-job
  script:
    - make verify test_fancy
  after_script:
    - make coverage
  coverage: '/\d+.\d+%/'
  artifacts:
    when: always
    paths:
      - cover.xml
    reports:
      junit: cover.xml

tests_without_cgo:
  extends:
    - .cached-job
    - .go-matrix-job
    - .test-job
  variables:
    CGO_ENABLED: 0
  script:
    - make verify test_fancy

tests:fips:
  image: ${FIPS_IMAGE}
  extends:
    - .cached-job
    - .test-job
  variables:
    FIPS_MODE: 1
    GOLANG_FIPS: 1
  before_script:
    # The FIPS UBI image does not ship git, which the SSHD acceptance tests
    # need to build the Gitaly seed bundle.
    - dnf install -y git
    - !reference [.test-job, before_script]
  script:
    - make test_fancy

race:
  extends:
    - .cached-go-job
    - .go-matrix-job
    - .test-job
  script:
    - make test_race

acceptance:
  stage: test
  extends:
    - .cached-go-job
    - .go-matrix-job
  needs: ["modules:download"]
  rules: !reference [".rules:go-changes", rules]
  script:
    - make acceptance-test

# Verify gitlab-sshd's negotiated SSH algorithms against a committed ssh-audit
# policy so a dependency bump that silently adds or drops a cipher, key exchange
# or MAC fails the pipeline. See support/ssh-audit/README.md.
.ssh-audit-base:
  stage: test
  extends:
    - .cached-go-job
  needs: ["modules:download"]
  rules: !reference [".rules:ssh-audit", rules]
  # Overriding cache replaces the list inherited from .cached-go-job, so
  # *cached_go must be listed again alongside the ssh-audit cache.
  cache:
    - *cached_go
    - *cached_ssh_audit
  script:
    - make ssh-audit-test

ssh-audit:
  extends: .ssh-audit-base

ssh-audit:fips:
  extends: .ssh-audit-base
  image: ${FIPS_IMAGE}
  variables:
    FIPS_MODE: 1
    GOLANG_FIPS: 1
    SSH_AUDIT_POLICY: support/ssh-audit/gitlab-sshd-fips.policy
    SSH_AUDIT_HOST_KEY_TYPES: "rsa ecdsa"
  before_script:
    # The FIPS UBI image ships neither ssh-keygen (from openssh) nor python3,
    # both of which the ssh-audit harness needs.
    - dnf install -y openssh python3

check_gitaly_version:
  stage: lint
  rules: *workflow_rules
  ## In case the job fails, mark the job as warning
  ## That way we don't block the pipeline but we warn the user
  allow_failure: true
  script:
    - chmod +x ./support/lint_gitaly_version.sh
    - ./support/lint_gitaly_version.sh

# SAST
semgrep-sast:
  stage: lint
  rules: *workflow_rules

gitlab-advanced-sast:
  stage: lint
  rules: *workflow_rules

# Dependency Scanning
gemnasium-dependency_scanning:
  stage: lint
  rules: *workflow_rules

# Secret Detection
secret_detection:
  stage: lint
  rules: *workflow_rules

# Danger
# git 6.0.0 removed Git::Base, which danger 9.6.1 still uses, so the job crashes
# on load: https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/ruby/gems/gitlab-dangerfiles/-/work_items/108
# Once danger supports git 6, drop this override and pass
# `gitlab_dangerfiles_version: "~> 4.9.2"` to the component instead.
danger-review:
  before_script:
    - bundle init
    - bundle add git --version "< 6"
    - bundle add gitlab-dangerfiles --version "~> 4.9.2"
    - bundle install

build-package-and-qa:
  stage: post-test
  trigger:
    project: "gitlab-org/build/omnibus-gitlab-mirror"
    branch: "master"
    strategy: depend
  inherit:
    variables: false
  variables:
    GITLAB_SHELL_VERSION: $CI_MERGE_REQUEST_SOURCE_BRANCH_SHA
    TOP_UPSTREAM_SOURCE_PROJECT: $CI_PROJECT_PATH
    TOP_UPSTREAM_SOURCE_REF: $CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME
    TOP_UPSTREAM_SOURCE_JOB: $CI_JOB_URL
    ee: "true"
  rules:
    # For MRs that change dependencies, we want to automatically ensure builds
    # aren't broken. In such cases, we don't want the QA tests to be run
    # automatically, but still available for developers to manually run.
    - if: "$CI_MERGE_REQUEST_IID"
      changes:
        - go.sum
      variables:
        BUILD_ON_ALL_OS: "true"
        MANUAL_QA_TEST: "true"
      allow_failure: false
    # For other MRs, we still provide this job as a manual job for developers
    # to obtain a package for testing and run QA tests.
    - if: "$CI_MERGE_REQUEST_IID"
      when: manual
      allow_failure: true
  needs: []

modules:tidy:
  stage: lint
  needs: ["modules:download"]
  script:
    - go mod tidy
    - git diff --exit-code go.mod go.sum

lint:
  stage: lint
  script:
    # Write the code coverage report to gl-code-quality-report.json
    # and print linting issues to stdout in the format: path/to/file:line description
    # remove `--issues-exit-code 0` or set to non-zero to fail the job if linting issues are detected
    - apt update && apt install -y jq
    - make lint GOLANGCI_LINT_ARGS="--output.code-climate.path=gl-code-quality-report-temp.json --output.text.path=stdout"
    - cat gl-code-quality-report-temp.json | jq '[ .[] | select(.severity == "warning").severity |= "minor" ]' > gl-code-quality-report.json
    - rm -f gl-code-quality-report-temp.json
  artifacts:
    reports:
      codequality: gl-code-quality-report.json
    paths:
      - gl-code-quality-report.json

nilaway:
  stage: lint
  rules: !reference [".rules:go-changes", rules]
  before_script:
    - go install go.uber.org/nilaway/cmd/nilaway@${NILAWAY_VERSION}
  script:
    - NILAWAY_EXIT_CODE=$(${GOPATH}/bin/nilaway -include-pkgs="gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab-shell/v14" ./... > /tmp/out.txt 2>&1 ; echo $?) || true
    - cat /tmp/out.txt
    - exit ${NILAWAY_EXIT_CODE}

logging-field-validator:
  stage: test
  needs: ["modules:download"]
  rules:
    - changes:
        - .gitlab-ci.yml
        - "go.mod"
        - "go.sum"
        - "**/*.go"
        - .labkit_logging_todo.yml
  script:
    - make validate-log-fields

################################################################################
# Release jobs
#
# See "Release Process" in README.md. Both jobs only run on the canonical
# project, never on the security or dev.gitlab.org mirrors, and need these
# protected and masked CI/CD variables:
#
# - GITLAB_SHELL_RELEASE_TOKEN: project access token with the `api` scope and
#   the Maintainer role, to create the release merge request and the tag.
# - SECURITY_REPO_READ_TOKEN: token with the `read_api` scope and at least the
#   Reporter role in gitlab-org/security/gitlab-shell, to refuse versions a
#   security release already tagged there.
################################################################################

.release-job:
  stage: release
  # The glab image ships git, jq and glab, but not bash.
  image: registry.gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli:${GLAB_VERSION}
  needs: []
  # Serialize release jobs so two pipelines can't prepare or tag concurrently.
  resource_group: release
  variables:
    # The full history and tags are needed to compute the changelog.
    GIT_DEPTH: 0
  before_script:
    - apk add --no-cache bash

.rules:release-canonical-only:
  rules:
    # Never run on the security or dev.gitlab.org mirrors.
    - if: '$CI_SERVER_HOST != "gitlab.com" || $CI_PROJECT_PATH != "gitlab-org/gitlab-shell"'
      when: never

# Opens the "Release vX.Y.Z" merge request. Run it manually from a `main`
# pipeline; set RELEASE_BUMP to `patch` or `major` when running the job to
# override the default `minor` bump. It also runs on scheduled pipelines that
# set RELEASE_BUMP.
release:prepare:
  extends: .release-job
  rules:
    - !reference [".rules:release-canonical-only", rules]
    - if: '$CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == $CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH && $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "schedule" && $RELEASE_BUMP'
    - if: '$CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == $CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH && $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE != "schedule"'
      when: manual
      allow_failure: true
  script:
    - support/release.sh prepare

# Creates the vX.Y.Z tag and its GitLab release, with the CHANGELOG section as
# release notes, once the release merge request is merged. Renovate then opens
# the merge request that bumps GITLAB_SHELL_VERSION in gitlab-org/gitlab.
release:tag:
  extends: .release-job
  rules:
    - !reference [".rules:release-canonical-only", rules]
    - if: '$CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == $CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH && $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "push"'
      changes:
        - VERSION
  script:
    - support/release.sh tag

# pipemaster:emulated step.script pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/pipemaster-changes
on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    tags:
      - '**'
env:
  FF_USE_FASTZIP: "true"
  TRANSFER_METER_FREQUENCY: 1s
  GOPATH: $CI_PROJECT_DIR/.GOPATH
  DEBIAN_VERSION: trixie
  POLICY: pull
  CI_DEBUG_SERVICES: "true"
  GO_VERSION: "1.26"
  NILAWAY_VERSION: v0.0.0-20260915140140-59aa42bdc591
  UBI_VERSION: "9.6"
  GITLAB_ADVANCED_SAST_ENABLED: "true"
  IMAGE_TAG: latest
  DEFAULT_IMAGE: registry.gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab-build-images/debian-${DEBIAN_VERSION}-golang-${GO_VERSION}:${IMAGE_TAG}
  FIPS_IMAGE_TAG: latest
  FIPS_IMAGE: registry.gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab-build-images/ubi-${UBI_VERSION}-golang-${GO_VERSION}:${FIPS_IMAGE_TAG}
  GOTOOLCHAIN: local
  GLAB_VERSION: v1.120.0
jobs:
  pipemaster-changes:
    if: '!github.event.deleted'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      c27af4a2a: ${{ steps.changes.outputs.c27af4a2a }}
      c5083c033: ${{ steps.changes.outputs.c5083c033 }}
      cd92799ed: ${{ steps.changes.outputs.cd92799ed }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - id: changes
        env:
          EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
          REF_TYPE: ${{ github.ref_type }}
          BEFORE: ${{ github.event.before }}
          AFTER: ${{ github.sha }}
          BASE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          RE_c27af4a2a: ^(\.gitlab-ci\.yml|go\.mod|go\.sum|(.*/)?[^/]*\.go)$
          RE_c5083c033: ^(\.gitlab-ci\.yml|go\.mod|go\.sum|(.*/)?[^/]*\.go|\.labkit_logging_todo\.yml)$
          RE_cd92799ed: ^(Makefile|support/ssh-audit/(.*/)?[^/]*)$
        run: |-
          set -eu
          files="$(mktemp)"
          all=false
          for rev in "${BEFORE:-}" "${AFTER:-}" "${BASE:-}" "${HEAD:-}"; do

  - event: push

        AFTER="$${DRONE_COMMIT_AFTER:-}"

    commands:
      - |-
        set -eu
        mkdir -p .git/pipemaster-changes
        cat > /tmp/pipemaster-changes.sh <<'PIPEMASTER_CHANGES_EOF'
        set -eu
        files="$$(mktemp)"
        all=false
        for rev in "$${BEFORE:-}" "$${AFTER:-}" "$${BASE:-}" "$${HEAD:-}"; do
          case "$$rev" in -*) echo "pipemaster-changes: refusing the commit value $$rev, which starts with a dash" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac
        done
        diff_paths() {
          git -c core.quotepath=off diff -z --name-only --no-renames --end-of-options "$$@" > "$$files" ||
            { echo "pipemaster-changes: cannot compute the changed paths for $$*" >&2; exit 1; }

        case "$$EVENT" in
          push)
            if [ "$$REF_TYPE" = tag ] || [ "$$BEFORE" = 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000 ]; then
              all=true
            else
              if ! git cat-file -e "$$BEFORE^{commit}" 2>/dev/null; then
                git fetch --no-tags --quiet origin --end-of-options "$$BEFORE" || echo "pipemaster-changes: git fetch failed for $$BEFORE" >&2

              if ! git cat-file -e "$$BEFORE^{commit}" 2>/dev/null; then
                echo "pipemaster-changes: the commit before the push ($$BEFORE) is not in the clone, as after a force push; GitLab documents no verdict for this" >&2

              diff_paths "$$BEFORE" "$$AFTER"

          pull_request)
            diff_paths "$$BASE...$$HEAD" ;;

            all=true ;;

          # would also anchor at a newline inside a name.
          if [ "$$all" = true ]; then
            echo true
            return
          fi
          while IFS= read -r -d '' name; do
            if [[ $$name =~ $$1 ]]; then
              echo true
              return
            fi
          done < "$$files"
          echo false
        }

        if { [ "$$A_c5083c033" = true ]; }; then res=true; fi
        printf '%s' "$$res" > ".git/pipemaster-changes/c5083c033"

          push) EVENT=push; REF_TYPE=branch ;;
          tag) EVENT=push; REF_TYPE=tag ;;
          pull_request) EVENT=pull_request; REF_TYPE=branch ;;

        AFTER="$${DRONE_COMMIT_AFTER:-}"

    image: buildpack-deps:trixie-scm@sha256:d524aa66d91264606eddea5b94af462fc3b969b84a1d4083e537a9ab84b579c5
    environment:
      RE_c27af4a2a: ^(\.gitlab-ci\.yml|go\.mod|go\.sum|(.*/)?[^/]*\.go)$$
    commands:
      - |-
        set -eu
        mkdir -p .git/pipemaster-changes
        cat > /tmp/pipemaster-changes.sh <<'PIPEMASTER_CHANGES_EOF'
        set -eu
        files="$$(mktemp)"
        all=false
        for rev in "$${BEFORE:-}" "$${AFTER:-}" "$${BASE:-}" "$${HEAD:-}"; do
          case "$$rev" in -*) echo "pipemaster-changes: refusing the commit value $$rev, which starts with a dash" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac
        done
        diff_paths() {
          git -c core.quotepath=off diff -z --name-only --no-renames --end-of-options "$$@" > "$$files" ||
            { echo "pipemaster-changes: cannot compute the changed paths for $$*" >&2; exit 1; }
        }
        case "$$EVENT" in
          push)
            if [ "$$REF_TYPE" = tag ] || [ "$$BEFORE" = 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000 ]; then
              all=true
            else
              if ! git cat-file -e "$$BEFORE^{commit}" 2>/dev/null; then
                git fetch --no-tags --quiet origin --end-of-options "$$BEFORE" || echo "pipemaster-changes: git fetch failed for $$BEFORE" >&2
              fi
              if ! git cat-file -e "$$BEFORE^{commit}" 2>/dev/null; then
                echo "pipemaster-changes: the commit before the push ($$BEFORE) is not in the clone, as after a force push; GitLab documents no verdict for this" >&2
                exit 1
              fi
              diff_paths "$$BEFORE" "$$AFTER"
            fi ;;
          pull_request)
            diff_paths "$$BASE...$$HEAD" ;;
          *)
            all=true ;;
        esac
        hit() {
          # Each NUL-separated name is matched as a whole string: bash [[ =~ ]] anchors at the string ends, where grep
          # would also anchor at a newline inside a name.
          if [ "$$all" = true ]; then
            echo true
            return
          fi
          while IFS= read -r -d '' name; do
            if [[ $$name =~ $$1 ]]; then
              echo true
              return
            fi
          done < "$$files"
          echo false
        }
        A_c27af4a2a="$$(hit "$$RE_c27af4a2a")"
        res=false
        if { [ "$$A_c27af4a2a" = true ]; }; then res=true; fi
        printf '%s' "$$res" > ".git/pipemaster-changes/c27af4a2a"
        PIPEMASTER_CHANGES_EOF
        case "$$DRONE_BUILD_EVENT" in
          push) EVENT=push; REF_TYPE=branch ;;
          tag) EVENT=push; REF_TYPE=tag ;;
          pull_request) EVENT=pull_request; REF_TYPE=branch ;;
          *) EVENT=other; REF_TYPE=branch ;;
        esac
        BEFORE="$${DRONE_COMMIT_BEFORE:-}"
        AFTER="$${DRONE_COMMIT_AFTER:-}"
        HEAD="$$AFTER"
        BASE=
        if [ "$$EVENT" = pull_request ]; then
          case "$${DRONE_TARGET_BRANCH:-}" in ""|-*) echo "pipemaster-changes: the pull request names no usable target branch" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac
          git fetch --no-tags --quiet origin --end-of-options "$$DRONE_TARGET_BRANCH" ||
            { echo "pipemaster-changes: cannot fetch the target branch $$DRONE_TARGET_BRANCH" >&2; exit 1; }
          BASE="$$(git rev-parse --verify FETCH_HEAD)"
        fi
        export EVENT REF_TYPE BEFORE AFTER HEAD BASE
        exec bash /tmp/pipemaster-changes.sh
  - name: script
    image: $${DEFAULT_IMAGE}
    commands:
      - 'if ! [ "$$(cat .git/pipemaster-changes/c27af4a2a 2>/dev/null)" = ''true'' ]; then exit 0; fi # pipemaster:guard'
      - |-
        sh -c 'if command -v bash >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec bash -e -c "$$1"; fi; exec sh -e -c "$$1"' pipemaster 'export PIPEMASTER_VARS=2; export CI_PROJECT_DIR="$${DRONE_WORKSPACE}"; export GOPATH="$$CI_PROJECT_DIR/.GOPATH"; : pipemaster-end; make build
        cp config.yml.example config.yml
        go version
        make test_race'

apiVersion: tekton.dev/v1
kind: Pipeline
metadata:
  name: gitlab-ci
spec:
  params:
    - name: ctx-branch
      default: ""
    - name: ctx-event
      default: ""
    - name: ctx-sha
      default: ""
    - name: ctx-repo
      default: ""
    - name: ctx-ref-name
      default: ""
    - name: ctx-ref-type
      default: ""
    - name: ctx-before-sha
      default: ""
    - name: ctx-pr-base-sha
      default: ""
  workspaces:
    - name: pipemaster-workspace
  tasks:
    - name: pipemaster-changes
      taskRef:
        name: gitlab-ci-pipemaster-changes
      params:
        - name: ctx-event
          value: $(params.ctx-event)
        - name: ctx-ref-type
          value: $(params.ctx-ref-type)
        - name: ctx-repo
          value: $(params.ctx-repo)
        - name: ctx-sha
          value: $(params.ctx-sha)
        - name: ctx-before-sha
          value: $(params.ctx-before-sha)
        - name: ctx-pr-base-sha
          value: $(params.ctx-pr-base-sha)
    - name: acceptance
      taskRef:
        name: gitlab-ci-acceptance
      runAfter:
        - modules-download
      when:
        - input: $(tasks.pipemaster-changes.results.s27af4a2a)
          operator: in
          values:
            - "true"
      matrix:
        params:
          - name: GO_VERSION
            value:
              - "1.26"
              - "1.27"
      workspaces:
        - name: pipemaster-workspace
          workspace: pipemaster-workspace
    - name: build-package-and-qa
      taskRef:
        name: gitlab-ci-build-package-and-qa
      params:
        - name: ctx-repo
          value: $(params.ctx-repo)
        - name: ctx-ref-name
          value: $(params.ctx-ref-name)
      when:
        - input: pipemaster-disabled
          operator: in
          values:
            - never
    - # pipemaster:id check_gitaly_version
      name: check-gitaly-version
      taskRef:
        name: gitlab-ci-check-gitaly-version
      runAfter:
        - modules-download
      onError: continue
    - name: danger-review
      taskRef:
        name: gitlab-ci-danger-review
      runAfter:
        - check-gitaly-version
        - gemnasium-dependency-scanning
        - gitlab-advanced-sast
        - lint
        - modules-download
        - modules-tidy
        - nilaway
        - secret-detection
        - semgrep-sast
      workspaces:
        - name: pipemaster-workspace
          workspace: pipemaster-workspace
    - # pipemaster:id gemnasium-dependency_scanning
      name: gemnasium-dependency-scanning
      taskRef:
        name: gitlab-ci-gemnasium-dependency-scanning
      runAfter:
        - modules-download
    - name: gitlab-advanced-sast
      taskRef:
        name: gitlab-ci-gitlab-advanced-sast
      runAfter:
        - modules-download
    - name: lint
      taskRef:
        name: gitlab-ci-lint
      runAfter:
        - modules-download
      workspaces:
        - name: pipemaster-workspace
          workspace: pipemaster-workspace
    - name: logging-field-validator
      taskRef:
        name: gitlab-ci-logging-field-validator
      runAfter:
        - modules-download
      when:
        - input: $(tasks.pipemaster-changes.results.s5083c033)
          operator: in
          values:
            - "true"
    - # pipemaster:id modules:download
      name: modules-download
      taskRef:
        name: gitlab-ci-modules-download
      matrix:
        params:
          - name: GO_VERSION
            value:
              - "1.26"
              - "1.27"
      workspaces:
        - name: pipemaster-workspace
          workspace: pipemaster-workspace
    - # pipemaster:id modules:tidy
      name: modules-tidy
      taskRef:
        name: gitlab-ci-modules-tidy
      runAfter:
        - modules-download
    - name: nilaway
      taskRef:
        name: gitlab-ci-nilaway
      runAfter:
        - modules-download
      when:
        - input: $(tasks.pipemaster-changes.results.s27af4a2a)
          operator: in
          values:
            - "true"
    - name: race
      taskRef:
        name: gitlab-ci-race
      runAfter:
        - modules-download
      when:
        - input: $(tasks.pipemaster-changes.results.s27af4a2a)
          operator: in
          values:
            - "true"
      matrix:
        params:
          - name: GO_VERSION
            value:
              - "1.26"
              - "1.27"
      workspaces:
        - name: pipemaster-workspace
          workspace: pipemaster-workspace
    - # pipemaster:id release:prepare
      name: release-prepare
      taskRef:
        name: gitlab-ci-release-prepare
      params:
        - name: ctx-branch
          value: $(params.ctx-branch)
        - name: ctx-event
          value: $(params.ctx-event)
        - name: ctx-repo
          value: $(params.ctx-repo)
      when:
        - input: pipemaster-disabled
          operator: in
          values:
            - never
    - # pipemaster:id release:tag
      name: release-tag
      taskRef:
        name: gitlab-ci-release-tag
      params:
        - name: ctx-branch
          value: $(params.ctx-branch)
        - name: ctx-event
          value: $(params.ctx-event)
        - name: ctx-repo
          value: $(params.ctx-repo)
      when:
        - input: pipemaster-disabled
          operator: in
          values:
            - never
    - # pipemaster:id secret_detection
      name: secret-detection
      taskRef:
        name: gitlab-ci-secret-detection
      runAfter:
        - modules-download
    - name: semgrep-sast
      taskRef:
        name: gitlab-ci-semgrep-sast
      runAfter:
        - modules-download
    - name: ssh-audit
      taskRef:
        name: gitlab-ci-ssh-audit
      runAfter:
        - modules-download
      when:
        - input: $(tasks.pipemaster-changes.results.s26c71e33)
          operator: in
          values:
            - "true"
      workspaces:
        - name: pipemaster-workspace
          workspace: pipemaster-workspace
    - # pipemaster:id ssh-audit:fips
      name: ssh-audit-fips
      taskRef:
        name: gitlab-ci-ssh-audit-fips
      runAfter:
        - modules-download
      when:
        - input: $(tasks.pipemaster-changes.results.s26c71e33)
          operator: in
          values:
            - "true"
      workspaces:
        - name: pipemaster-workspace
          workspace: pipemaster-workspace
    - name: tests
      taskRef:
        name: gitlab-ci-tests
      runAfter:
        - modules-download
      when:
        - input: $(tasks.pipemaster-changes.results.s27af4a2a)
          operator: in
          values:
            - "true"
      matrix:
        params:
          - name: GO_VERSION
            value:
              - "1.26"
              - "1.27"
      workspaces:
        - name: pipemaster-workspace
          workspace: pipemaster-workspace
    - # pipemaster:id tests:fips
      name: tests-fips
      taskRef:
        name: gitlab-ci-tests-fips
      runAfter:
        - modules-download
      when:
        - input: $(tasks.pipemaster-changes.results.s27af4a2a)
          operator: in
          values:
            - "true"
      workspaces:
        - name: pipemaster-workspace
          workspace: pipemaster-workspace
    - # pipemaster:id tests_without_cgo
      name: tests-without-cgo
      taskRef:
        name: gitlab-ci-tests-without-cgo
      runAfter:
        - modules-download
      when:
        - input: $(tasks.pipemaster-changes.results.s27af4a2a)
          operator: in
          values:
            - "true"
      matrix:
        params:
          - name: GO_VERSION
            value:
              - "1.26"
              - "1.27"
      workspaces:
        - name: pipemaster-workspace
          workspace: pipemaster-workspace

files.text:
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: EventSource
metadata:
  name: pipemaster-github
spec:
  github:
    pull_request:
      active: true
      contentType: json
      events:
        - pull_request
      repositories:
        - names:
            - REPO
          owner: OWNER
      webhook:
        endpoint: /pull_request
        method: POST
        port: "12000"
        url: ""
      webhookSecret:
        key: token
        name: pipemaster-github-webhook
    push:
      active: true
      contentType: json
      events:
        - push
      repositories:
        - names:
            - REPO
          owner: OWNER
      webhook:
        endpoint: /push
        method: POST
        port: "12000"
        url: ""
      webhookSecret:
        key: token
        name: pipemaster-github-webhook
  service:
    ports:
      - port: 12000
        targetPort: 12000

apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: Sensor
metadata:
  name: pipemaster
spec:
  dependencies:
    - eventName: pull_request
      eventSourceName: pipemaster-github
      filters:
        data:
          - path: body.action
            type: string
            value:
              - opened
              - reopened
              - synchronize
        exprs:
          - expr: head == base
            fields:
              - name: head
                path: body.pull_request.head.repo.full_name
              - name: base
                path: body.repository.full_name
      name: gitlab-ci-pr
    - eventName: push
      eventSourceName: pipemaster-github
      filters:
        data:
          - path: body.ref
            type: string
            value:
              - ^refs/heads/main$
      name: gitlab-ci-push
    - eventName: push
      eventSourceName: pipemaster-github
      filters:
        data:
          - path: body.ref
            type: string
            value:
              - ^refs/tags/.*$
      name: gitlab-ci-tag
  template:
    serviceAccountName: pipemaster-sensor
  triggers:
    - template:
        conditions: gitlab-ci-pr
        k8s:
          operation: create
          parameters:
            - dest: spec.arguments.parameters.0.value
              src:
                dataKey: body.pull_request.head.ref
                dependencyName: gitlab-ci-pr
            - dest: spec.arguments.parameters.1.value
              src:
                dependencyName: gitlab-ci-pr
                value: pull_request
            - dest: spec.arguments.parameters.2.value
              src:
                dataKey: body.pull_request.head.sha
                dependencyName: gitlab-ci-pr
            - dest: spec.arguments.parameters.3.value
              src:
                dataKey: body.repository.full_name
                dependencyName: gitlab-ci-pr
            - dest: spec.arguments.parameters.4.value
              src:
                dependencyName: gitlab-ci-pr
                value: branch
            - dest: spec.arguments.parameters.6.value
              src:
                dataKey: body.pull_request.base.sha
                dependencyName: gitlab-ci-pr
          source:
            resource:
              apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
              kind: Workflow
              metadata:
                generateName: gitlab-ci-
              spec:
                arguments:
                  parameters:
                    - name: ctx-branch
                      value: ""
                    - name: ctx-event
                      value: ""
                    - name: ctx-sha
                      value: ""
                    - name: ctx-repo
                      value: ""
                    - name: ctx-ref-type
                      value: ""
                    - name: ctx-before-sha
                      value: ""
                    - name: ctx-pr-base-sha
                      value: ""
                serviceAccountName: pipemaster-workflow
                workflowTemplateRef:
                  name: gitlab-ci
        name: gitlab-ci-pr
    - template:
        conditions: gitlab-ci-push
        k8s:
          operation: create
          parameters:
            - dest: spec.arguments.parameters.0.value
              src:
                dataTemplate: '{{ trimPrefix "refs/heads/" .Input.body.ref }}'
                dependencyName: gitlab-ci-push
            - dest: spec.arguments.parameters.1.value
              src:
                dependencyName: gitlab-ci-push
                value: push
            - dest: spec.arguments.parameters.2.value
              src:
                dataKey: body.after
                dependencyName: gitlab-ci-push
            - dest: spec.arguments.parameters.3.value
              src:
                dataKey: body.repository.full_name
                dependencyName: gitlab-ci-push
            - dest: spec.arguments.parameters.4.value
              src:
                dependencyName: gitlab-ci-push
                value: branch
            - dest: spec.arguments.parameters.5.value
              src:
                dataKey: body.before
                dependencyName: gitlab-ci-push
          source:
            resource:
              apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
              kind: Workflow
              metadata:
                generateName: gitlab-ci-
              spec:
                arguments:
                  parameters:
                    - name: ctx-branch
                      value: ""
                    - name: ctx-event
                      value: ""
                    - name: ctx-sha
                      value: ""
                    - name: ctx-repo
                      value: ""
                    - name: ctx-ref-type

# pipemaster:emulated ext.passthrough pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/acceptance/step/script/carry
# pipemaster:arg {"digest":"739bb4f73638a2d2b880d53472f75659eca8e087d9c3adb77834b63ef39fcd4d","carry":"id: script
kind: script
"}
# pipemaster:emulated job.matrix pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/acceptance
# pipemaster:arg {"matrix":"axes:
    - name: GO_VERSION
      values:
        - "1.26"
        - "1.27"
","across":"[{"max_in_flight":"all","values":["1.26","1.27"],"var":"GO_VERSION"}]"}
# pipemaster:emulated job.manual pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/acceptance
# pipemaster:arg {"manual":false,"held":true,"cond":true}
# pipemaster:emulated ext.passthrough pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/acceptance/carry
# pipemaster:arg {"digest":"0ef3c2cc83680c0815506fe36c1105f635e1ce15d1858dfa5c606e402bfb4c3f","carry":"if: changes('.gitlab-ci.yml', 'go.mod', 'go.sum', '**/*.go')
container:
    ref: ${DEFAULT_IMAGE}
matrix:
    axes:
        - name: GO_VERSION
          values:
            - "1.26"
            - "1.27"
id: acceptance
runner:
    labels:
        - gitlab-org
needs:
    - job: modules:download
env:
    - name: CACHE_COMPRESSION_LEVEL
      value:
        lit: fastest
cache:
    - key: golang-${GO_VERSION}-cache-${{ hashFiles('go.mod', 'go.sum') }}
      policy: $POLICY
      paths:
        - .GOPATH/pkg/mod/
"}
# pipemaster:emulated job.manual pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build-package-and-qa
# pipemaster:arg {"manual":false,"held":true,"cond":true}
# pipemaster:emulated ext.passthrough pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build-package-and-qa/carry
# pipemaster:arg {"digest":"11c155c68a7e5f225a9cc8bb71b4f354a50c0d4d72c5e7b65006f73d070b076d","carry":"if: |
    opaque(gitlab): - allow_failure: false
      changes:
        - go.sum
      if: $CI_MERGE_REQUEST_IID
      variables:
        BUILD_ON_ALL_OS: "true"
        MANUAL_QA_TEST: "true"
    - allow_failure: true
      if: $CI_MERGE_REQUEST_IID
      when: manual
container:
    ref: ${DEFAULT_IMAGE}
id: build-package-and-qa
runner:
    labels:
        - gitlab-org
env:
    - name: GITLAB_SHELL_VERSION
      value:
        lit: $CI_MERGE_REQUEST_SOURCE_BRANCH_SHA
    - name: TOP_UPSTREAM_SOURCE_PROJECT
      value:
        expr: repo
    - name: TOP_UPSTREAM_SOURCE_REF
      value:
        expr: ref_name
    - name: TOP_UPSTREAM_SOURCE_JOB
      value:
        lit: $CI_JOB_URL
    - name: ee
      value:
